data.name: Info_Problems_What
data.value: Gathers what the analyzer and the validator see in your montage, and why each task of the run failed or is blocked.

data.name: Info_Problems_Actions
data.value: Look at the errors first. Select a line to see its detail. Fix the montage or retry the task from the monitor.

data.name: Info_Output_What
data.value: Shows live what the task or the agent you selected does. If you select nothing, it shows the whole run.

data.name: Info_Output_Actions
data.value: Select a task or an agent on the canvas. Read the last thing it did. Go back to the whole run by clearing the selection.

data.name: Info_Tests_What
data.value: Shows the verifications the system made: which step it was, how many tests passed and which failed. No agent writes them.

data.name: Info_Tests_Actions
data.value: See which step failed and its main error. Run the tests of HEAD: it spends no quota. Go back to the monitor to retry the task.
